An AI agent becoming more confident should not mean it automatically gains more authority.

I built Kingpin, a runtime capability-governance demo that keeps attention, confidence, concern, and authority separate.

Live demo: https://putmanmodel.github.io/kingpin-weak-signal-demo/

Feedback, technical critique, and thoughtful collaboration are welcome.
